div.div:
50 Ω SE (SMA side) · 75 Ω SE (BNC side) · 90 Ω differential (USB)
widths from the JLCPCB impedance calculator, vias from Saturn PCB Toolkit

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 878px; height: 1px; padding-top: 607px; margin-left: 62px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1F2328;
display: inline-block; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Segoe UI'; color: light-dark(#1F2328, #cdd0d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;
div.span:
• Never route RF or USB over a gap in the L2 ground plane
• GND via next to every signal via → short return path (also for the SPI bus)
• Via fence along RF lines
• ESD diodes right at the connectors with a short ground return
• RF section shielded by the milled aluminium case (pockets per section)
